title: Mileage Step Added to the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan Fee
content:
A mileage step is added to the protection fee for the exposure the included miles carry. The miles a trip
includes are read from the Keyturn Trip Booking beneath the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan election.

- Where the trip includes 3000 miles or more, a step of 90.00 USD is added.
- Where the trip includes 1500 miles or more but fewer than 3000, a step of 45.00 USD is added.
- Where it includes fewer than 1500 miles, a step of 0.00 USD is added.

The step is added after the fee has been held at the level's floor and then under the trip ceiling that applies,
and the step itself is not held down by that ceiling.

## Both sides of the two thresholds

| Miles the trip includes | Step added |
|---|---|
| 1499 | 0.00 USD |
| 1500 | 45.00 USD |
| 2999 | 45.00 USD |
| 3000 | 90.00 USD |

## Worked on hypothetical trips

A weekend trip including 400 miles carries no mileage step. A week's trip including 1750 miles carries
45.00 USD. A month's trip including 4500 miles carries 90.00 USD. The step is one flat amount for the trip: a
trip including 12000 miles carries the same 90.00 USD as one including 3000.
